question: For which of the following teams is the former Indian football captain Sunil Chhetri played in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru FC.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The former Indian football captain Sunil Chhetri played for** Bengaluru FC in 2021.**
 
• Sunil Chhetri has become the highest goalscorer in Indian football, known as the 'Goal Machine'.
 
 
• With 47 goals in six editions, the poster boy of Indian football is the top goal-scoring Indian in the Indian Super League.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/005a1314a154137892b136b6d2d42033e1537bacd12e8022a67ae4e0864065d4.png]

• Baichung Bhutia is a retired Indian footballer of the Sikkim-Bhutia dynasty.
